newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Sri Lanka buys end Apr diesel, jet from Glencore.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka buys end Apr diesel, jet from Glencore.

text.p: Sri Lanka's state-owned Ceylon Petroleum Corp (CPC) bought by tender 200,000 barrels of diesel and 80,000 barrels of jet fuel from Swiss trader Glencore for April 21-22 delivery, cost-and-freight (c-and-f) Colombo, a CPC source said on Thursday.
The 1.0-percent sulphur diesel was purchased at 39 cents per barrel above Singapore spot quotes, and jet fuel at a 20-cent premium.
Glencore also won Sri Lanka's previous tender for April 11-12 delivery with diesel sold at a 47-cent premium and jet fuel at a 40-cent premium, c-and-f Colombo.
